stem.en: A 1 kg ball and a 3 kg ball roll across the floor at the same speed. How does the kinetic energy of the 3 kg ball compare with that of the 1 kg ball?

text.en: It is the same, because the speeds are equal.
It is three times as large.
It is nine times as large.
It is one third as large.

explanation.en: K = 1/2 mv^2. The speeds are equal, so the kinetic energy is in proportion to the mass. The 3 kg ball has three times the mass, so it has three times the kinetic energy. Only the speed is squared, not the mass, so the answer is not nine times.

hints.en: Which quantities in K = 1/2 mv^2 are the same for both balls?
Is the mass squared in the formula?
